options.text: A very large population, which prevents chance changes in allele frequencies

A very large population, which prevents chance changes in allele frequencies is incorrect: A large population helps maintain equilibrium and would not cause a heterozygote deficit.
No mutation, because the alleles are not changed is incorrect: The absence of mutation would help keep equilibrium.
